title: Lawrence Krauss inviting Joe Rogan to Epstein Island

tellings.quote: Who invited Rogan to Epstein Island?

plain: A comedian named Kurt Metzger, speaking on a podcast about Jeffrey Epstein, a wealthy financier who owned a private Caribbean island, raises the question of who invited Joe Rogan, a famous podcast host, to that island. According to Metzger, the answer is Lawrence Krauss, a well-known physicist. He tells it as a sign of how Epstein's circle reached into science and media.
